correctness.rationale: In orthonormal (p,q) coordinates the error matrix has rows (0,-h/a) and (-alpha h,1-alpha b). Direct independent SymPy expansion of det(I-T^T T) agrees identically with -r^2+2y-[1+(1-r^2)s^2]y^2. If r>=1, ||T q||>=r; if r<1 the determinant criterion gives exactly the root interval. Setting alpha=1/b gives norm max(r,s), bounded by (kappa-1)/(2sqrt(kappa)) by AM-GM on rotated diagonal SPD matrices. Choosing tan(theta)=sqrt(mu/L) forces r to attain this value for every alpha, proving exact minimax, including kappa=1, h=0 and the critical 3+2sqrt2 threshold.
